parsed.notes:
Required and Preferred set their respective section defaults; the opening candidate-expertise statement also supplies requirements.
The longer Snowflake quote identifies its required mention rather than its responsibilities-only mention.
Text-to-SQL and semantic/knowledge-layer design are unmapped techniques; neither is expanded into SQL, RAG, knowledge graphs, or data modeling.
SAP, JDE and M3 data concepts are read literally as domain knowledge and excluded.
Certifications are credentials, not additional technical skills; their titles do not independently establish machine-learning or software-architecture requirements.
Technologies and practices appearing only under What You’ll Do are excluded.
Terraform/CloudFormation contains only one taxonomy-mapped skill, so no alternative group with at least two mapped skills is emitted.
